how.title: How to play
how.s1: Choose your bet. The − and + buttons change the bet by one step; tapping the bet amount opens every step. “{max}” picks the highest step your balance covers.
how.s2: Spin. Press the big button or use the space bar. The bet amount ({multiple} times the bet when Chance ×2 is on) is taken from your balance once.
how.s3: Match. On the 6 column × 5 row grid you win when there are 8 or more of the same candy anywhere; the more there are, the higher the pay tier.
how.s4: Chain. Winning candies burst, the ones above fall and new candies fill the gaps. This continues until there are no new wins.
how.s5: Result. The whole round is decided by the engine before the spin starts; the animation only plays that result back. The Spin button stays locked until the round (every tumble and free spin) has finished; use the {quick}/{turbo} setting to speed things up. Speed settings, tapping the celebration counter, a hidden tab or leaving the page never change the payout; the round always closes once, with the engine’s payout.
how.note: DEMO credit has no value; it does not earn SOL, tokens or rewards. The game runs in the browser with local randomness; there is no VRF proof.

pay.title: Paytable
pay.lead: You win with 8 or more of the same candy anywhere on the grid. The large figure is the gross DEMO amount at a bet of {bet}; the multiplier below it is a multiple of the bet.
pay.scatterText: When the base spin ends, 4 or more stars on the grid pay and unlock {spins} free spins. Stars do not burst.
pay.crystalText: Only drops in free spins and carries a value from 2× to 100×. At the end of the spin the crystals on the grid are summed; if that spin has a win it is multiplied by the total.
pay.maxText: At this bet that is {amount}. If the round total reaches this cap the round ends immediately; remaining free spins are not played.

features.title: Features
features.tumbleText: After every win the winning candies burst, the rest slide down and the gaps fill from above. The win meter never resets during a round: tumbles, multipliers and all free spins add up in the same total.
features.starText: When a base spin ends, 4 or more stars pay and unlock {trigger} free spins. In free spins, 3 or more stars add {retrigger} more spins (no payout). A single round plays at most {max} free spins.
features.crystalText: Only drop in free spins and carry a value from 2× to 100×. When the spin ends, the values of the crystals on the grid are summed; if that spin’s win is above zero, it is multiplied by this total. With no win, the crystals have no effect.
features.freeText: Free spins are played at the same bet within the same round; no extra fee is charged. They always end with the “{screen}” screen: spins played, the crystal multipliers applied and the total win.
features.tiersText: When the round total is 10× your base bet or more, the celebration screen opens and the counter climbs through the tiers: {big} ≥10×, {mega} ≥25×, {super} ≥50×, {epic} ≥100×; a round that reaches the cap ends with {max}. Wins below 10× get a short highlight on the meter. Multiplier totals of 10× and above are announced in large type above the grid. Tapping the screen jumps the counter to the result; it never changes the payout.
features.anteText: While on, every spin costs {multiple} times your bet and stars are more likely in the base game: the free-spin chance is roughly double ({ante} / {standard}). Wins are still paid on the base bet. The bonus can’t be bought while it is on.
features.buyText: For 100 times your bet the round starts with at least 4 stars; {spins} free spins are guaranteed. The purchase is made through a confirmation window, runs at a separate RTP ({rtp}) and can’t be used with autoplay.

rtp.title: RTP
rtp.heading: Theoretical return (RTP)
rtp.caption: Theoretical return per mode
rtp.method: A separate simulation of {millions} million rounds for each mode (engine candy-cascade-2). RTP is calculated against the amount paid. Hit frequency (base spin): standard {hit}, Chance ×2 {hitAnte}.
rtp.note: The simulation is an estimate and is uncertified; because of the heavy tail the confidence interval may be optimistic. Results in a short session can differ greatly from the RTP. DEMO credit has no value.

limits.title: Bet and win limits
limits.maxValue: {n} times the bet · {amount} at this bet
limits.p1: A round that reaches the max win ends immediately; remaining free spins are not played. The payout is always calculated on the base bet, with fractions of a cent rounded down.
limits.p2: Steps and modes your balance can’t cover can’t be selected. A round is a single reservation and a single payout; only one round is played at a time.

keys.title: Keys
keys.heading: Keyboard
keys.spaceText: Starts the spin ({settings} → “{option}”). During a round it doesn’t skip the spin; it only speeds up the free-spin cards and the celebration counter.
keys.escText: Closes the open window (except the session reminder).
keys.tabText: Moves between controls; focus is always visible.
keys.arrowsText: Switches pages in this info window; changes the option in setting choices.
keys.note: The screen reader announces every step (“{example}”, the round result); the grid is read as a 6×5 table. The reduced-motion preference turns off particles and shaking.

fault.title: Fault clause
fault.p1: A fault voids all affected games and payouts. In case of a software, browser or device fault the round record is authoritative; an amount that appears on screen but does not match the engine record is not valid.
fault.p2: This game is played with DEMO credit only. DEMO has no value and cannot be converted to money or tokens; in case of a fault the DEMO balance and session history may be corrected or reset.
fault.p3: Because the result is decided before the spin, an animation that is cut short, a hidden tab or leaving the page does not change the result; the round still closes once with the engine’s payout.
